description: Boruta, the devil nobleman of Polish legends, unmistakably a devil: a red-skinned devil face with a pointed black beard, a thin black moustache and a sly grin, glowing yellow eyes, two small curved black horns sticking out of his fur kolpak cap, a short white heron feather on the cap, a long green Polish kontusz coat over a red zupan, a wide gold and red sash at the waist, a curved sabre in his hand, a thin devil tail with a black tuft at its end, one leg ending in a black goat hoof and the other foot in a red boot, menacing, standing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture, the whole feather inside the picture
